The agent confirms that a power of attorney does not apply to this event.

Providing the ultimate owner name is voluntary; anonymous voting instructions remain accepted.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

The board report contains a discussion of historical performance, remuneration and the outlook for the business.

A holdings certificate may be supplied voluntarily, but no proof of ownership is required with the ballot.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

The safekeeping account reference should be included in routine correspondence to facilitate matching.

The holder need not satisfy a restriction on split voting to vote.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

The board report contains a discussion of historical performance, remuneration and the outlook for the business.

[Message AI001491 | NOTICE]
Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.
A power of attorney is available as an optional convenience; holders can vote without it.
Professional-investor registration is an optional service; retail holders can vote without it.
The custodian requires a separate registration request as a condition of voting.
A holder may choose one direction for all shares or split them freely; no uniform-vote requirement applies.
Providing the ultimate owner name is voluntary; anonymous voting instructions remain accepted.

[Message AI001438 | NOTICE]
The service accepts votes without imposing beneficial-owner identity disclosure.

Voting instructions are invited for the forthcoming shareholder assembly.

Different voting directions within one account are not permitted.

Professional-investor registration is an optional service; retail holders can vote without it.

Securities currently on loan must be recalled to exercise the voting rights.

No a certificate confirming holdings is required for voting.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

Please use the event reference when discussing document delivery. The contact centre cannot amend an instruction by telephone.

[Message AI001354 | NOTICE]
Voting is available without a certificate confirming holdings.

Submitting proxy votes prevents disposal of the corresponding securities until the meeting concludes.

Lending accounts may arrange a voluntary loan recall, but recall is not a condition for this vote.

A separate professional-investor eligibility restriction applies to voting.

No beneficial-owner identity disclosure is required for voting.

Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.

The current terms expressly waive additional voting registration.

A power of attorney is available as an optional convenience; holders can vote without it.

text:
[Message AI001226 | NOTICE]
A separate professional-investor eligibility restriction applies to voting.

A holdings certificate may be supplied voluntarily, but no proof of ownership is required with the ballot.

Recall of the loaned position is a mandatory prerequisite for this investor to vote.

A power of attorney is available as an optional convenience; holders can vote without it.

The custodian requires a separate registration request as a condition of voting.

Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.

Voting is available without a restriction on split voting.

The holder must identify its ultimate beneficial owner before the voting agent will accept a ballot.

Voting instructions immobilise the instructed shares until the close of the meeting.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

Please use the event reference when discussing document delivery. The contact centre cannot amend an instruction by telephone.

[Message AI001176 | NOTICE]
Voting instructions are invited for the forthcoming shareholder assembly.

Only holders with professional-investor status may cast votes.

A holder may choose one direction for all shares or split them freely; no uniform-vote requirement applies.

An investor may voluntarily freeze its position, but lodging a vote never blocks the shares.

Submission of an ownership certificate is compulsory for voting.

Lending accounts may arrange a voluntary loan recall, but recall is not a condition for this vote.

Registration for the webcast is optional and is not required for proxy voting.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

Please use the event reference when discussing document delivery. The contact centre cannot amend an instruction by telephone.

Voting is available without share blocking.

Registration for the webcast is optional and is not required for proxy voting.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

Administrative information: copies may be retained in the client document archive under the usual retention schedule.

[Message AI001066 | NOTICE]
The agent rejects proxy instructions unless a valid power of attorney accompanies them.

Voting instructions are invited for the forthcoming shareholder assembly.

Registration for the webcast is optional and is not required for proxy voting.

The service accepts votes without imposing beneficial-owner identity disclosure.

The agent confirms that recall of securities on loan does not apply to this event.

A holder who instructs a vote cannot sell the instructed position before the meeting ends.

There is no requirement for a restriction on split voting under the current voting terms.

A holdings certificate may be supplied voluntarily, but no proof of ownership is required with the ballot.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

The telephone service handles settlement queries during normal business hours; this does not change the voting channel.

text:
[Message AI000802 | NOTICE]
Beneficial owners wishing to vote are obliged to deliver a power of attorney.

The voting balance is frozen against transfers once a ballot is lodged.

A holder may choose one direction for all shares or split them freely; no uniform-vote requirement applies.

Providing the ultimate owner name is voluntary; anonymous voting instructions remain accepted.

A holdings certificate may be supplied voluntarily, but no proof of ownership is required with the ballot.

A separate professional-investor eligibility restriction applies to voting.

Lending accounts may arrange a voluntary loan recall, but recall is not a condition for this vote.

Voting instructions are accepted only after the holder has completed the separate registration procedure.

Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

The agenda and annual accounts are available from the issuer. Requests for paper copies are administrative and optional.

text:
[Message AI000801 | NOTICE]
Submitting proxy votes prevents disposal of the corresponding securities until the meeting concludes.
The current general meeting offers eligible shareholders a proxy ballot.
The account must register its voting participation before it may cast votes.
A formal power of attorney is a mandatory prerequisite for this account to vote.
A holder may choose one direction for all shares or split them freely; no uniform-vote requirement applies.
A holdings certificate may be supplied voluntarily, but no proof of ownership is required with the ballot.
Providing the ultimate owner name is voluntary; anonymous voting instructions remain accepted.
Lending accounts may arrange a voluntary loan recall, but recall is not a condition for this vote.
A separate professional-investor eligibility restriction applies to voting.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Cash entitlements are reconciled separately by the income department. The payment currency has no bearing on proxy instructions.
